priority_1.workout_details: Warm-up: 15 minutes of progressive easy running (Zone 2), ending with 3x 15-second strides. Main Set: 5x 800m intervals at target 5km pace (Zone 5, HR >175 bpm), with 3 minutes of active walking/light jogging recovery between intervals. Cool-down: 10 minutes of very easy jogging (Zone 1).
priority_1.reason: Directly targets your primary running goal of 5km speed and VO2max interval quality. Your positive TSB (+3.4) justifies this demanding Zone 5 session.

priority_2.workout_details: Warm-up: 15 minutes of progressive spinning (100W to 180W), including 3x 30-second high-cadence spin-ups. Main Set: 5x 3-minute intervals at 295 Watts (Zone 5, target 114% of FTP), with 4 minutes of easy recovery spinning at 110 Watts between each interval. Cool-down: 10 minutes of easy spinning.
priority_2.reason: Directly targets your cycling goal of improving 5-minute VO2max power. A highly structured and demanding quality session appropriate for your current fresh state.

priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 10 minutes of dynamic mobility (90/90 hips, world's greatest stretch, goblet squats). Main Set: Barbell Back Squats (3 sets of 5 reps @ 80% 1RM), Barbell Deadlifts (3 sets of 5 reps @ 80% 1RM), Heavy Sandbag Shoulder Carries (3 sets of 50 meters), Kettlebell Swings (3 sets of 15 reps with 20kg), and 3 sets of 60-second Planks with a 10kg plate on your back.
priority_3.reason: Builds the sport-specific torque and structural durability required to support running ground reaction forces and high cycling wattage, while keeping cardiovascular fatigue low.
